title: Sindh Prohibition of Taking Minerals Including Reti Sand and Bajri from any Land Act 2003

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Prohibition of Taking Minerals Including Reti Sand and Bajri from any Land Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2003
ACT IV OF 2003
SINDH (PROHIBITION
OF TAKING MINERALS JDING RETI (SAND) AND BAJRI FROM ANY LAND) ACT, 2003
An Act to provide
for the prohibition of taking minerals including reti (sand and bajri from any
land) by excavation or otherwise, in the Province of Sindh.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 23rd October, 2003]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-6/2003, dated
23-10-2003. The Sindh (Prohibition of taking minerals including reti (sand)
and bajri from any Land) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of Sindh on 18th September, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on
4th October, 2003, is hereby published as an Act of the legislature of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Sindh (Prohibition of Taking
Minerals including Reti (Sand and Bajri from any Land) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Definitions.--In this
Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context--
(a)
"Government" means the Government of Sindh;
(b)

(c)

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Prohibition of Taking Minerals Including Reti Sand and Bajri from any Land Act 2003
sections.description:
Restriction on taking minerals including reti (sand) and bajri

ACT IV OF 2003
ACT IV OF 2003
SINDH (PROHIBITION
OF TAKING MINERALS JDING RETI (SAND) AND BAJRI FROM ANY LAND) ACT, 2003
An Act to provide
for the prohibition of taking minerals including reti (sand and bajri from any
land) by excavation or otherwise, in the Province of Sindh.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 23rd October, 2003]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-6/2003, dated
23-10-2003. The Sindh (Prohibition of taking minerals including reti (sand)
and bajri from any Land) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of Sindh on 18th September, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on
4th October, 2003, is hereby published as an Act of the legislature of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
3. Restriction on taking
minerals including reti (sand) and bajri.--Except with the prior sanction
of Government, no person shall take minerals including reti (sand) and bajri
from any land by excavation or otherwise:
Provided that no sanction shall
be accorded if it adversely affects the Topography, Archaeology, Ecology and
Environments of that area.

ACT IV OF 2003
ACT IV OF 2003
SINDH (PROHIBITION
OF TAKING MINERALS JDING RETI (SAND) AND BAJRI FROM ANY LAND) ACT, 2003
An Act to provide
for the prohibition of taking minerals including reti (sand and bajri from any
land) by excavation or otherwise, in the Province of Sindh.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 23rd October, 2003]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-6/2003, dated
23-10-2003. The Sindh (Prohibition of taking minerals including reti (sand)
and bajri from any Land) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of Sindh on 18th September, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on
4th October, 2003, is hereby published as an Act of the legislature of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
4. Punishment.--Whosoever
contravenes any of the provisions of this Act, shall, on conviction, be
punishable.--
(a) in the case
of first conviction with imprisonment which may extend to three months and
fine, not exceeding ten thousand rupees; and
(b) in the case
of any subsequent conviction with imprisonment which may extend to one year and
fine, not exceeding twenty thousand rupees.
